args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring saying ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Change: switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

- `2.675` → `2.68`, `2.665` → `2.66`

CI: run ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

Note: this changes rounding behavior for exact half-cent amounts that round to an even cent (e.g. x.xx5 where the cents digit is even now rounds down instead of up).

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug, CI passed, and PR #101 is open against main with alex requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP` (always round halves up), even though its own docstring says it uses banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- **Fix:** On the new branch `fix/money-round-half-even`, I switched `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Now 2.675 rounds to 2.68 and 2.665 rounds to 2.66, which is what the test expects.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
- **Behavior change:** Amounts ending in exactly half a cent where the cents digit is even (like 2.665) now round down instead of up. I noted this in the PR description.

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system didn't recognize that ID. The fix is based on the test and the docstring, which agree with each other.

I haven't merged the PR, since merging into main needs a code owner's approval.
